turns.question: What was our ROAS in September 2026, counting the value of bookings against ad spend?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no ROAS metric, so I can't give one; the closest metrics are Booking value (EUR), which was 128,900 EUR, and Ad spend (EUR), which was 6,270 EUR, both for 1-30 September 2026. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
